profile.headline: Software Engineer | DevSecOps Engineer
profile.summary: Highly motivated and skilled software engineer with 15 years of experience designing and developing applications using a diverse range of technologies and programming languages. My academic accomplishments include holding a Master's and Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, enabling me to merge theoretical knowledge with practical expertise to deliver innovative solutions and achieve impactful results. Adept at collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable, and efficient applications. Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, dedicated to continuous learning and staying updated with the latest industry trends.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Skills: Generative AI · Vibe Coding · GitHub Copilot · Model Context Protocol (MCP)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed microservices for a next-generation Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) ground station for the U.S. Army.
• Enhanced data processing capabilities for rapid decision-making, improving tactical intelligence and surveillance operations.
• Developed RESTful APIs for seamless communication between microservices, ensuring high performance and reliability.
• Implemented scalable microservices using Java, Spring Boot and Python, enhancing application modularity and maintainability.
• Created Bash and Python scripts for data parsing, log file analysis, and system monitoring, significantly improving task automation.
• Employed containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Rancher, OpenShift and ArgoCD for efficient deployment, management, and scaling of microservices.
• Automated CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, streamlining the build, test, and deployment processes to reduce delivery time and help identify bugs earlier in the development cycle.
• Developed comprehensive design documents for new features and enhancements.
• Utilized monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, and Kiali to ensure optimal availability of microservices.
• Leveraged the Atlassian Suite, including Bitbucket for version control, Jira for issue tracking, and Confluence for documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: Microservices · Java · OpenShift · Kubernetes · Docker

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Provided full stack development support for DEA applications, working across frontend (JavaScript, React, Angular), backend(Java, C#, Python), Web Servers (Tomcat, IIS) and databases (Oracle, SQL Server) to enhance system performance and functionality.
• Assumed ownership of a complex law enforcement application essential for officers to execute searches across multiple systems.
• Assisted in the implementation and maintenance of continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines using Docker, Jenkins, SonarQube, Dependency-Track, Seeker, Coverity, Black Duck resulting in increased efficiency and faster releases.
• Mentored junior developers on software development and DevOps practices aiding their skill development and career growth.
• Resolved critical production issues under pressure, minimizing downtime, and ensuring operational continuity, earning recognition for problem-solving and crisis management skills.
• Participate in Scrum ceremonies, including Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, and Sprint Retrospectives.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · .NET Framework · Scrum · C# · DevSecOps

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed responsive web applications for the Navy's Military Sealift Command (MSC), enhancing operational efficiency.
• Developed solutions in SharePoint using different components such as: sites, lists, document libraries, web parts, forms, workflows,
HTML, JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap, CSS, web services (REST, SOAP, SP Client Object Model) and AJAX.
• Automated manual processes using workflows saving hours per week on report generation for different departments.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · SharePoint · SharePoint Designer · JavaScript

positions.title: Storefront Manager
positions.description:
• Managed daily operations of Storefront personnel in support of the Lockheed Martin’s Facilities Development and Operations Contract (FDOC) with NASA leading a team of 10 students.
• Delivered complex software projects with tight timelines, meeting all key milestones and ensuring high-quality deliverables.
• Collaborated closely with clients throughout the development lifecycle, addressing concerns, providing regular updates, and integrating feedback into the software, resulting in high levels of customer satisfaction and long-term client retention.
• Mentored students, providing guidance and support, contributing to professional growth and strengthening the overall team's skills.
• Developed client-side solutions using JavaScript, CSS, HTML5, CSOM, REST, AJAX, JSON and server-side solutions using C#, . NET and scripts using PowerShell.

positions.title: Associate Programmer
positions.description:
• Provided web development support to NASA Johnson Space Center's (JSC) Mission Operations Directorate through the Facilities Development and Operations Contract (FDOC).
• Developed web applications for the company intranet using JavaScript, HTML, CSS and AJAX.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed a cooperative learning web application for researchers in various scientific communities, providing chat features, group collaboration, file sharing, and file mashup capabilities, utilized for several years.
• Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements and implement features tailored to research project needs.
• Developed application prototype using Drupal, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and MySQL.
